title: Stir-Fried Shiitake and Irish Stew
description: A twist on traditional stew, this recipe combines the earthy flavors of shiitake mushrooms and Irish potatoes with a hint of pepper and a velvety texture.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced shiitake mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the diced Irish potatoes, peppery ground pepper, and velvety soy sauce. Stir to combine.
Pour in the stew broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, covered, for 15-20 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot and garnish with sliced scallions or green onions, if desired.
